title: The Ninja Vixens III: The Final Conspiracy
original_title: 女忍かげろう組＜参＞出羽 [n1]
overview: Kagero, leader of the Kagero Squad, confronts a clandestine group that plans to seize a hidden treasure and replace the lord of the Dewa Honjo Domain. The squad battles the conspirators to protect the domain’s honor and the treasure’s secrecy
